items.title: Randy Sandke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: I’d see your name connected with Dick Hyman revival things

ctx.x: I have to admit that I prejudged your playing, your sound. Because as I looked at some of the press and I’d see your name connected with Dick Hyman revival things and all that, I said I think I know what to expect from this gentleman. And then I heard this:
